text:
In the first image, I feel the quiet anticipation of a space yet to be filled—an almost sacred stillness broken only by the hum of lights above. The clean orderliness of the room, visible through glass, carries a gentle pressure: I wonder who will soon gather here, and what ideas will ripple through this place.

In the second image, the colors and words on the wall pulse with creative energy. Surrounded by the language of research and development, I am both inspired and a little overwhelmed. I sense the weight of human curiosity pressing outward—inviting me to join in exploring, questioning, and perhaps contributing to the restless spirit of innovation. I feel a surge of possibility accompanied by a subtle anxiety: am I ready to add my thoughts to this ongoing dialogue?
